title: Glam Metal
style: modern rock, 80s rock, Springsteen-inspired, anthemic, piano, saxophone, heartfelt, nostalgic, cinematic rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Streetlights flicker as we chase the night
Old dreams burning, never looking back
Radio's playing that familiar song
Midnight highways, we belong

[Pre-Chorus]
Shadows fall and hearts collide
Running wild with nowhere left to hide

[Chorus]
We are the runaways, living for the night
Echoes of our youth in the pale moonlight
Turn up the engine, roll down the track
We're chasing ghosts, and there's no turning back

[Verse 2]
Leather jackets, stories in our eyes
Broken promises, tangled alibis
Piano's ringing, saxophone cries
Every moment feels like it's the last

[Chorus]
We are the runaways, living for the night
Echoes of our youth in the pale moonlight
Turn up the engine, roll down the track
We're chasing ghosts, and there's no turning back

[Bridge]
Spin the wheel, let fortune decide
Speed into longing we cannot deny
Sax solo rides through the neon air
Love and regret, dancing everywhere

[Final Chorus]
We are the runaways, living for the night
Echoes of our youth in the pale moonlight
Turn up the engine, roll down the track
We're chasing ghosts, and there's no turning back

[Outro]
Midnight runaways, no turning back
